title: App shell
description: The frame of a multi-page app: a floating bento sidebar (w-52, collapses to a w-14 icon rail) on bg-canvas, the content panel beside it, and MobileTabBar at the bottom on phones. This docs site is an AppShell.
when: Every app with several pages (dashboards, admin, store back office).

instead.need: A single-screen tool or editor (3D, canvas)

a11y: The sidebar is a nav landmark; the active item has aria-current; the collapse state is remembered per app (storageKey).
notes: Render it once in the root layout (or a route group layout); pages render only their content.
Use next/link hrefs for items; onSelect is for in-page sections.
MobileTabBar is used by AppShell; render it yourself only in a custom shell.

examples.title: Root layout
examples.description: AppShell fills the viewport, so it is shown as code: this very page is the live example.
